description: Risk rules used by bug:risk. Scores are additive and capped at 100.

rules.reason: World/Studio has critical mobile boot history and a large lazy module graph.
tests: real iPhone Create -> World -> interactive -> close/reopen

rules.reason: These files orchestrate dynamic ESM loading in the mobile World path; regressions can appear as hangs, duplicate module state or Safari-only boot failures.
tests: real iPhone World open twice without reload

rules.reason: Authentication/session changes can block the entire player entry path.
Updater/service-worker changes can affect every client and stale-cache recovery.
Network/authority defects can corrupt multiplayer state or silently reject edits.
Render/canvas changes can create device-specific crashes, memory pressure or frame stalls.
Large or duplicated assets can increase decode/GPU/WebContent memory and trigger mobile-only instability.
tests: repeat open/close smoke while watching memory symptoms

rules.reason: Combat changes have high player-facing regression cost and timing sensitivity.
Persistence changes can block boot or lose player/editor state.
